title: SPLIT SECOND
subtitle: Action and consequence — withheld release, phase alignment, and impact
lineage: Primary: SCION 084 (Pickpocket) · Supporting: SCION 069 (A Movie), SCION 082 (First Position)
theorem: Create a sequence around release using six bounded excerpts. Twice cut away immediately before a hand lets go. On the third return, allow the object's actual consequence to arrive. Align later actions by phase, let one hesitation resist, and end on an ordinary release.
boundary_note: Matches visible action phases (grip, threshold of release, fall, contact) rather than claiming identical inner decisions or historical simultaneity.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #05 (t=14.00s-19.50s): `874e1f7f` contains internal cuts across dark industrial slats with no drop into liquid or splash.
Seg #07 (t=23.30s-29.80s): `61aca239` cuts internally from factory bottles to a clenched fist.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Seg #05 shows dark industrial slats with internal cuts instead of a drop into liquid, and Seg #07 cuts mid-shot instead of holding an object without letting go.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: OpenCLIP mismatch on `874e1f7f` and unverified scene cut inside `61aca239`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Seg #05 with verified cut-free liquid drop/stream impact `5a786b16` (`0.2s-5.7s`, 8.1s clean window) and replace Seg #07 with human-verified cut-free shot of hands holding family photographs without letting go (`b066405d`, `0.1s-6.0s`, 6.1s clean window).
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The three-part withheld-release grammar across Seg #02, #03, and #04 (`0870ef3a` and `9e7292f1`), where the third return completes the release of the 'SORROW' block, and the ordinary fabric release at the close (`3e4b0f51`).
